text:
priya: quick FYI, new onboarded model marlin-liteq (int8) is failing structured-output parsing in a weird way many failures are JSONDecodeError(Invalid control character) rather than trailing-data. spike from ~0.4% -> 3.9% on toolcall harness at 09:18 UTC.
dan: which slice + config?
priya: bench run: 3k-toolcall-sample (slice-2026-04-02-x). config: model=marlin-liteq, quant=int8, batch=4, streaming=on, escape_normalization=enabled.
bench-ci: run summary:
```
job: bc-7771
samples: 3000
parse_failure_rate: 0.039
mode: invalid-controlchar
common_pattern: unescaped_newline_in_string / backslash-escape-loss
```
yuki: can you paste a sanitized failing output? even one minimal case helps.
priya: pasted safe example (user prompt removed):
```
{"action":"call","name":"send_msg","arguments":{"text":"Hello\nWorld\""}}
```
priya: the string contains literal newline and an escaped quote but the model sometimes outputs the newline as raw control char (not escaped) or drops the backslash before the quote.
ben: hmm that's different from split-blob duplicates. sounds like the tokenizer/quant combo is dropping escape backslashes or mapping them to separate tokens. int8 rounding could shift probability away from escape char tokens.
dan: timeline: was escape_normalization change deployed recently?
priya: yes, we flipped a normalization pass that attempts to canonicalize escaped sequences pre-onboard. it was enabled in the same push as int8. earlier int16 canary with normalization off had parse_fail 0.6%.
bench-ci: also noticed retries amplify the issue: when caller retry_policy triggers and we mirror with retry_count >1, sometimes second invocation returns semantically identical output but with different escaping, increasing funcall_invalid_count.
yuki: triage plan: 1) reproduce with escape_normalization=false 2) run int16 with normalization on to isolate quant vs normalization 3) add a soft repair that escapes control chars and reparse before giving up 4) tag repaired calls with header x-escape-repaired.
ben: i'll run (1) and (2) in parallel. samir (not in thread) can you also check mirror/retry interactions?
bench-ci: queued bc-7772: overrides escape_normalization=false, limit=1000. bc-7773: int16+norm_on, limit=1000.
mlops-bot: alert: canary marlin-liteq parse_failure_rate > 3% for 5m  hold promotion.
dan: do not promote to dedicated/hosted until we confirm.
bench-ci: bc-7772 interim: escape_normalization=false -> parse_fail 0.008 after 1k. bc-7773 interim: int16+norm_on -> parse_fail 0.007. signal: normalization pass + int8 interaction likely.
yuki: hypothesis: normalization expects stable tokenization of backslash sequences; int8 quant/decoder rounding sometimes emits backslash as separate token or drops it. when normalization runs on model output it can incorrectly rewrite sequences.
priya: short-term fixes: A) disable escape_normalization for int8 models in canary routing config B) implement output-sanitizer in SDK: before JSON parse, run a conservative escape-fix pass that replaces unescaped control chars with escaped versions and re-add missing backslashes before quotes inside strings (tag with x-escape-repaired) C) collect token traces/logits for failed examples for model team.
ben: agree. also reduce retry mirroring until we measure false_repair rate so we don't double-count.
dan: please add an experiment to run with retries=0 vs retries=2 to quantify amplification.
bench-ci: queued bc-7774: full 3k with repairs=on, norm_disabled=true, retries=0. link: https://bench.internal/runs/bc-7774
priya: i'll add owners: ben -> implement routing gating for norm+int8; yuki -> SDK sanitizer and repair header; dan -> retry matrix and dashboard; priya -> collect failing examples and token logits into s3://eng-ml/goldens/marlin-liteq/ for model devs.
bench-ci: bc-7774 completed: overall parse_fail dropped to 0.010; repaired_success_rate=0.048 (many rescued by sanitizer); false_repair_est=0.0018 on gold subset. full logs: https://bench.internal/runs/bc-7774/logs
mlops-bot: incident INC-7771 opened and linked to bc-7774.
yuki: note: sanitizer must be conservative to avoid changing semantics (we only escape lone control chars and re-add backslashes before immediate quotes inside strings). add telemetry counters: escape_repair_attempt and escape_repair_success.
ben: for medium-term: coordinate with model team to retrain/infer calibration for escape/backslash tokens or adjust tokenizer merges so backslash remains stable under int8. also consider kernel-level post-decoder smoothing to avoid dropping backslashes.
dan: follow-ups: run matrix streaming true/false x batch sizes 1/4/8 with norm_on/norm_off to ensure no other boundary cases. queueing now.
priya: summary: root cause likely interaction between escape_normalization pass and int8 quantized decoder causing loss of escape/backslash tokens -> invalid control chars. mitigations: gate normalization for int8, SDK sanitizer repair, reduce retry mirroring until stable, collect logits and failing examples. owners assigned.
ben: will keep routing block for 24h and revert once parse_fail <1% on canary.
priya: thanks everyone. please drop any minimal failing traces into the golden s3 path. closing when dashboard stable.
